messages.subject: Error in Goodness of fit test for colext models
parts:
Hello Everyone,

I have been working with unmarked models, specifically colext models, for the past year. I have been modeling detection, occupancy, colonization, and extinction for an invasive species and I have a large dataset that I am working with and it does have a lot of NAs. Below you can find the summary output for the umf data frame for more detail. My models look good in terms of parameter estimates and SE however when I go to check gof of the global model I get an error that I can't seem to figure out or find a way to fix (please see the error below). If anyone has come across this error or may know what may be causing it, I would greatly appreciate any help.

Some Code:

> summary( umf )

> pm4 <- colext( ~1, ~1, ~1, ~date+Var_1+Var_2, umf )    # Global Model just for example
>det_gof <- mb.gof.test( pm4, nsim = 5, plot.hist = TRUE ) # nsim=5 just for example but get error no matter how many simulations I run

1: 0.76586956199248 + 0.23413043800752*
   ^
I greatly appreciate any help.

Thank you,
Josh Armstrong

messages.author: 4e956cc50ac3e075
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] Error in Goodness of fit test for colext models
parts:
Hi,

The problem reported by Joshua was related to having seasons without
any sites sampled. Removing these seasons that did not have any data
solved the problem.

Best,

Marc
